The {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} of {wiki:Okolnir|Okolnir} guard a small treasure in their lair. Go down the island's holes, kill the dragons and hatchlings along the way and survive the last room, with five Frost Dragons, to open the chest with a {item:Shard}, a {item:Bullseye Potion} and 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Okolnir's Frost Dragons guard a small treasure in their home.
Having completed the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest}.
No minimum level, but level 50+ is recommended.
optional, to block the dragons in the last room
Low-level mages should use {spell:Mana Shield} in the last room.
In the last room, use {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Walls} and {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs} to stop many dragons from hitting you in melee at the same time.

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take the boat there from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). Go to the boat **south** of Svargrond and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:okolnir}. The trip costs 50 gp and only works after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest}.
If you have a {item:Dwarven Ring} with you, answer {key:no} to his first question.
Making sure you are on the right island
You may end up on the wrong island. If that happens, keep asking for passage to Okolnir until you reach the place in the image.

{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and often gets the destination wrong. If you carry a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack (and tell him yes when he asks for it), he takes you to the right place without charging, but you lose the ring.
Climb the ramp. You will meet between one and three {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}.
Follow the red arrow in the image to the next hole and go down. The green dots are possible Frost Dragons and the purple ones possible {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling|Frost Dragon Hatchlings}.
Follow the red arrow (green: Frost Dragons; purple: Hatchlings)
As soon as you go down, you see another hole. Here you may find a {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling} and maybe a Frost Dragon pulled from elsewhere. Go down the hole.
When you go down the hole you will find at least one {creature:Frost Dragon}, probably with at least one {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling}, and maybe one or two more Frost Dragons. Kill them all.
Black: Frost Dragons; purple: Hatchlings; blue: the quest chest
Walk **west**, as the image shows, and go down the hole. Down there, walk **west** to the rope spot, where there is a Frost Dragon. Kill it.
Use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot and climb up.

This last room has **five Frost Dragons**, and at least 4 will attack you as soon as you climb up. Low-level mages should use {spell:Mana Shield}. Use {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Walls} and {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs} to stop many of them from hitting you in melee.
Open the chest in the **northwest** of the room to receive the reward.

Go back the same way: go down the rope spot you climbed up, walk **east** to the hole you came through and climb up with the {item:Rope}. Repeat at the next holes (always with the Rope) until you are back on the surface of Okolnir, and go down the ramp to the boat.
The Frost Dragons you left behind may have respawned on the way back.

On Okolnir's boat talk to {npc:Buddel} again: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} (50 gp). Since he is drunk, you may end up on another island; in that case ask for {key:svargrond} again until you arrive.
